text: 狼群扑向你们，将队伍冲散。它们离得太近，来不及使用步枪；你只能拿起近战武器背水一战。狼群分散开来，准备围攻你们。
除非你之前已经减少狼的数量，否则共有2D6头恐狼。它们平均分配攻击你们每个人。若数量不能整除，第一头余狼攻击西尔维娅，第二头余狼攻击诺曼。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 307
text: The wolf pack hits your group and scatters it. They are too close for your rifle; you must make a desperate stand with melee weapons. The pack splits to overwhelm you.

Unless you have already reduced their number, there are 2D6 dire wolves. One-third of them attack each of you. If the number does not divide cleanly, the first leftover wolf targets Sylvia, and the second targets Norman.
